description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'OrderActionsControler' responsible for managing order-related actions in the admin panel of an e-commerce application. It includes methods for capturing payments, refunds, printing invoices, listing transactions, sending invoices via email, updating order statuses, and sending download links, all of which interact with order, customer, payment, and email services.

classes.name: OrderActionsControler
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administrative order actions such as capturing payments, refunds, printing invoices, and updating status, secured with role-based authorization.

methods.name: captureOrder
methods.description: Handles payment capture for an order, verifying existence and store ownership, then invoking the payment processing service.

methods.name: refundOrder
methods.description: Processes refund requests for an order, validating the order, refund amount, and customer details before invoking payment refund service.

methods.name: printInvoice
methods.description: Generates and streams a PDF invoice for an order, with order and store validation.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Fetches and lists all transactions linked to a specific order.

methods.name: sendInvoice
methods.description: Sends an order invoice via email to the customer, after retrieving order and customer details.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates order status and notifies the customer via email, including order history retrieval.

methods.name: sendDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends an email to the customer with download links or files related to the order.
